candidate_hypotheses: H1 shared-operator/canonical-cut planning with non-additive state costs
H2 authenticated incremental verification state with paid coin refresh or proved reuse
historical_scope: Q0-Q55 unchanged. E101 and E110 literal negative/containment decisions stand. Q51 stronger Fourier certificate unproved and off critical path.

thresholds.scope: Project decision thresholds, not promised gains or conference criteria; disclose all regressions and uncertainty.

tasks.label: B1
tasks.title: Complete native admission reference and controls
component_cap: One complete relation/schema; prepared native replay and checked-product/trusted-suffix modes; frozen tiny oracle plus one source geometry and held-out queries.
tasks.acceptance: All complete packet bytes match an independent oracle; full grammar/context/coverage negatives reject without a private callback.
tasks.falsifier: Stop expansion on an unsound/incomplete boundary; retain complete cost even when slow.

tasks.label: B2
tasks.title: Shared-operator and update-dependency discriminator
component_cap: One symbolic census at the existing 8k and 32k graphs; strongest bilinear/adjoint control; one targeted prior comparison.
tasks.acceptance: A precise transformation beyond the stopped E101 recipe and known batching, with a useful complete state/traffic budget.
tasks.falsifier: Stop H1 if ordinary specialization produces the same representation or dictionary/tape growth defeats the objective.

tasks.label: B3
tasks.title: Canonical-cut compiler prototype
component_cap: Four registered cut policies, tiny exhaustive oracle, one selected native rule, partial-group and second-geometry holdouts.
tasks.acceptance: Complete relation-preservation argument and resource difference against equally specialized known controls.
tasks.falsifier: No compiler if Q57 supplies no distinction; stop originality if generic elimination/batching matches it.

tasks.label: B4
tasks.title: Authenticated incremental verifier-state discriminator
component_cap: One state design; single-row, single-tile, dispersed32 and whole-snapshot edits; mutable generic/cache and fresh rebuild controls.
tasks.acceptance: Updated evaluator/checker state equals fresh enrollment, rejects mixed epochs, and pays rekeying or proves fixed-coin reuse.
tasks.falsifier: If H1 stops, H2 must establish its own prior-separated result; full rebuild or generic equivalence stops the candidate claim.

tasks.label: B5
tasks.title: Complete matched pilot of surviving candidate
component_cap: One preregistered panel: 8k/32k, five independent process/key blocks per size, fixed queries/updates, at most one candidate plus strong controls.
tasks.acceptance: All-party/link costs, exact outputs, measured bytes/state, resource qualifications and paired uncertainty; useful frontier under declared thresholds.
tasks.falsifier: No panel for no survivor; no winner from only a stage or an excluded mandatory cost.

tasks.label: B6
tasks.title: Choose full-system architecture and paper claim
component_cap: One claim/architecture decision after applicable packages; may close early when all candidates stop.
tasks.acceptance: Select H1, H1+H2, independently supported H2, known engineering only, or no useful survivor, with precise evidence.
tasks.falsifier: Do not reopen the old catalogue automatically or declare originality from ordinary known techniques.

tasks.label: B7
tasks.title: Protected service and security/assurance closure
component_cap: Selected architecture only: enrollment, requests, complete receipts, private finish, updates, concurrency, rollback/lifetime and real chosen TEE transport.
tasks.acceptance: Reviewed no-false-admission composition, actual deployment receipts, parameter/private-side-channel review and full fault tests.
tasks.falsifier: Do not expose experimental admission to production private keys or call a simulation deployed assurance.

tasks.label: B8
tasks.title: Full evaluation and paper artifact
component_cap: Selected regimes, approved comparable profiles, held-out workloads and reproducible ablations; no unfocused new parameter grid.
tasks.acceptance: Claims match algorithms, proofs, deployment and measured lifecycle results; candid comparison and limitations.
tasks.falsifier: If only known engineering survives, scope the paper accordingly; no unsupported original-main claim.

dependencies_note: Q57 is static design independent of Q56 implementation. Q59 can use B1 without H1 but must earn its own originality. Q60 requires a surviving Q58 or Q59 candidate. Q61 requires a recorded outcome for every predecessor: completed within scope or explicitly skipped because a prerequisite stopped. It may close early when all candidate routes stop; it may not select an original useful system without the applicable relation, prior and matched-measurement gates.
